_what: Every indexed Otočac Žubrinić baptism 1846-1858 whose father reads as a Michael variant, with the image ARK of the opening each one sits on.
_why: Work list row 1. The 1846-58 book writes the household into its Conditio column («Rustici Confiniarii e Šumećica N° 2»), so these openings carry the house numbers that question 4 turns on.
_caution: Neither q.birthLikeDate nor q.birthLikePlace binds; both were filtered by hand. The ARK is the OPENING, not the row, so each entry still costs two or three crops to find on the page. Surname spellings scatter: Zubrinić · Žubrinić · Xubrinić · Žubrinich · Dubrinić are one surname.
_read: Thomas Xubrinić 21 Dec 1846 is the N° 10 household already established (Michael x Helena Orešković of Prozor). The other fourteen are unread.

entries.note: Read 15 September 2026. Left page, second entry. **No village and no house number** — the Conditio holds the status words alone. Nor do any of the other entries on this page (July–August 1846): Agricola Confiniarius, Confiniarius, Sutor, Miles gregarius, all bare. The numbering practice had not started yet.

Read 15 September 2026. Right-hand page, seventh entry. The father is «Senior populi» — the elder of Obilje, a standing and not merely a trade. The mother's surname is absent from the index and the register gives it: a Žubrinich married to a Žubrinich.

Read 15 September 2026. Right page, third entry. Every entry on this opening carries a village and a number — Dubrava N° 49, Vivoze N° 40, Dubrava N° 41, Ottočac N° 8, Prozor N° 114, Dubrava N° 64, Dubrava N° 23, Poljica N° 25, Ottočac N° 55, Obilje N° 55, Vivoze N° 53.

Read 15 September 2026. Left page, first entry. **This opening is in Croatian, not Latin** — «Leta 1849 dne 4tog Studenoga bi Xerstjena u Xupnickoj Cerkvi Svetoga Trojstva u Otocu» — and the Conditio becomes *Graničar* for *Confiniarius* and *Br.* for *N°*. A search of this book that looks only for Latin forms will miss whole stretches of it. Neighbours on the page: Dubrava Br. 52, Dubrava Br. 15, Otočac Br. 8.

Read 15 September 2026. Croatian entry at the very foot of the left page, below where a first crop of the page stopped — the left page runs to 4 April and the right page begins at 8 April, so 6 April exists only in that last row. A second Žubrinić married to a Žubrinić.

Read 15 September 2026 and **confirmed at full resolution** in a second window the same hour. Right page, first entry, Croatian. Same household as Thomas 1846 — *Mio* is *Michael*, *Jele* is *Helena Orešković*, Šumećica N° 10.

Read 15 September 2026. Left page, third entry, Croatian. **The same household as Petrus in 1848** — *Rusticus e Poljica N° 13*, Michael × Magdalena Draženović. *Mande* is the Croatian familiar form of *Magdalena*, so the index's two mothers are one woman, and this is one house with two children three years apart.

Read 15 September 2026. Right page, Latin — **the book changes language from page to page, not merely from year to year**: this opening is Croatian on the left and Latin on the right. The father is a *miles gregarius*, a common soldier, not a Graničar.

Read 15 September 2026. Right page, Latin, page 216. **The index is wrong about the mother**: it gives «Maria Maković», the register gives «Maria nata Marković» — the same woman as the 1849 and 1855 entries, and the same house.

Read 15 September 2026. **The first entry of 1855, sitting below the year rule at the very foot of the left page** — a whole-page crop that stops at the usual table bottom misses it, which is the second time this book has hidden an entry there. Third child recorded to this household.

Read 15 September 2026. Right page, Latin. **The same house as Magdalena in January 1852, but a different wife** — Anna Bobinac then, Maria Rogić now. A remarriage, or two men under one roof; the register does not say which.

Read 15 September 2026. Right page, fourth entry, «die 8a Januarii» — the index date is right. Same house and same couple as Josephus 1855, but the status word has changed from *miles gregarius* to *Confiniarius*.
**Not read.** FamilySearch re-blocked at 04:51 UTC on 15 September 2026 with this one entry outstanding. It is the only one of the fifteen still to do.

Read 15 September 2026. Left page, third entry, page 290. **The fourth child recorded to this household** — Marta 1849, Magdalena 1852, Mathias 1855, Stephanus 1858 — and the status word has moved from *Graničar* through *Gregarius* and *Confiniarius* to *Rusticus* across those nine years, while the house number never moves.
